methodology.m2_baseline: The committed M2 baseline, 25 tests, early failure. Preserved unchanged and not used for speed comparison.
methodology.baseline_full: M2 baseline job with FULL_SCOPE=true: clean install with tests skipped, then mvn test -fae. PMD skipped. Warm cache, 626 tests, 43 reactor entries.
methodology.rescued: One mvn verify -fae -T 2 pass. PMD skipped. Warm cache, 626 tests, 43 reactor entries.
methodology.workload_equivalence: Both sides run the same 43 reactor entries, the same 626 tests and 220 failed/errored tests in this environment. M0C recorded 221; auth.controller.AuthControllerTest.testCreateDefaultUser appears order-sensitive and passes here; the cause is not proven. The one-test delta is recorded, not fixed.
methodology.cache: Warm /m2 cache, no cold-cache M3 claim.
methodology.excluded: PMD report-only goal, Docker build/push, mail and the Jenkins JaCoCo status step are excluded from both sides.
methodology.thread_choice: 1, 2 and 4 investigated once each; 2 chosen as the conservative final setting.

thread_investigation.selection_note: 2 is the conservative default for the 3 GiB agent; single runs at 1, 2 and 4 are investigation only. All three runs executed 626 tests and 220 failed/errored; M0C recorded 221, with one auth test passing here; the cause is not proven.

workload.delta_note: auth.controller.AuthControllerTest.testCreateDefaultUser appears order-sensitive and passes in the M3 runs; M0C recorded it as an InvalidUseOfMatchersException error. The cause is not proven.

test_inventory.m2_baseline_note: M2 baseline reached only 25 tests and is not used for the M3 speed comparison.

limitations: M2 baseline remains the 25-test early-failing run and is not used for the speed comparison.
